'''The Weaving''' is [[House Stormrider]]'s great custom: at decisions, alliances, and successions, a physical line is braided — one strand per party — into one. To refuse to braid in one's strand is a declaration of war. A broken or unraveled line in the archives is a memorial to a betrayal.

The Weaving's oldest archives are the subject of a persistent whisper: somewhere, it is said, lies a line with ''eleven'' strands — or one where a strand has been cut away. The archive-keepers do not comment. See [[The eleventh house]].
